title: Extraction and purification of viruses from stream biofilms
author: Meriem Bekliz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.32qgqdw
materials: Recover the supernatant for downstream analyses.
Pre-warm SDS at 37°C and CTAB at 65°C.

steps.title: Prepare buffers
steps.instruction: Make 200 × TE (2 M Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5 + 0.2 M EDTA), 1 × TE (10 mM Tris + 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0) and 10 × DNase buffer (100 mM Tris, pH 7.5 + 5 mM CaCl₂ + 25 mM MgCl₂).

steps.title: Initial low‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the biofilm sample at 100 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Concentrate viruses by TFF
steps.instruction: Concentrate viruses from the supernatant using tangential flow filtration (TFF) following the published protocol.

steps.title: Add TE, EDTA and formamide
steps.instruction: To the concentrated sample add 0.1 vol of 200 × TE buffer, 0.01 vol of 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8) and 1 vol of formamide; mix well and incubate at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Add DNase buffer
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 vol of 10 × DNase buffer to the mixture.

steps.title: Add tetrasodium pyrophosphate
steps.instruction: Add tetrasodium pyrophosphate to a final concentration of 5 mM.

steps.title: Sonicate on ice
steps.instruction: Sonicate the sample on ice three times for 1 min each with 30 s intervals; shake the tube between sonication intervals.

steps.title: Mid‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3 234 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Sequential filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the supernatant sequentially through a 0.8 µm filter followed by a 0.45 µm filter.

steps.title: DNase I treatment
steps.instruction: Add DNase I enzyme to a final concentration of 2.5 U µL⁻¹, then incubate for 3 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate DNase
steps.instruction: Heat‑inactivate DNase I at 65 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Check microbial contamination
steps.instruction: Perform a standard PCR with universal 16S rRNA primers and run the products on an agarose gel to assess bacterial contamination.

steps.title: Prepare sucrose gradient
steps.instruction: In a clean ultracentrifuge tube pipette 3 mL of 66 % (w/v) sucrose, then 7 mL of 30 % sucrose without mixing; mark the two layers with a permanent marker.

steps.title: Overlay sample on gradient
steps.instruction: Gently layer the sample on top of the sucrose gradient and fill the tube to the top, avoiding any mixing of the layers.

steps.title: Ultracentrifugation of gradient
steps.instruction: Ultracentrifuge at 106 800 × g for 2 h at 4 °C using slow acceleration and no brake; then incubate the tube in the dark for 15 min.

steps.title: Harvest gradient interface
steps.instruction: Using an 18 G needle, pierce the tube between the 66 % and 30 % sucrose layers and withdraw approximately 2 mL of material.

steps.title: SYBR Gold staining
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of 1000 × SYBR Gold to the harvested sample, mix, and incubate 30 min in the dark at room temperature.

steps.title: Filter onto Anodisc
steps.instruction: Filter the stained sample onto a 0.02 µm pore‑size Anodisc membrane filter.

steps.title: Mount filter for microscopy
steps.instruction: Place the filter on a glass slide with a drop of VectaShield mounting medium.

steps.title: Fluorescence imaging
steps.instruction: Observe the slide under a fluorescence microscope using 488 nm excitation (blue light) and collect emission at 512 nm (green).

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation of DNA
steps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of 100 % ethanol to the sample, incubate at 4 °C for 30 min, then centrifuge at 17 000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C to pellet DNA.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in 567 µL of 1 × TE buffer.

steps.title: Optional storage
steps.instruction: Store the resuspended DNA at –20 °C for up to one month.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of 10 % warm SDS and 3 µL of proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹); mix and incubate 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add NaCl and CTAB
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 5 M NaCl, mix, then add 80 µL of warm CTAB solution; vortex and incubate at 65 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: First chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform, vortex, and centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous (top) layer to a new tube, add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), vortex, and centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous layer to a new tube, add an equal volume of chloroform, vortex, and centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous layer to a fresh tube, add 0.7 vol of isopropanol, mix gently, and incubate at –20 °C overnight to precipitate DNA.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and wash the pellet twice with 70 % cold ethanol.

steps.title: Final DNA resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed DNA pellet in 50 µL of DNase‑free H₂O.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a Qubit fluorometer (or equivalent) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Final ethanol wash and dry
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet twice with 70 % ice‑cold ethanol and allow the pellet to air‑dry at room temperature.
